entries.question: For the blogging API comment editing feature (PUT /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id with body {"comment":{"body":"..."}}): who is allowed to edit a comment? What is the time limit after creation for an edit? How is an edited comment marked (field name, format)? How are errors returned (status codes, JSON error shape)? How are migrations and tests organised?
entries.answer:
**Who can edit:** The notes don't say. They only cover ownership for deletion: a comment belongs to the user in its `authorId`, and delete looks it up by id and current user id. Edit permission is not documented, so I can't confirm it's author-only.

**Time limit after creation:** Not covered by the notes.

**Edited marker:** A demo policy (not current app behaviour) says a comment gets a nullable timestamp field named `editedAt`. It stays null until the first edit, and each successful edit sets it to the edit time. The Comment model today has no `editedAt` field.

**Error responses:**
- Validation errors: status 422, body like `{"errors":{"body":["can't be blank"]}}`. A demo policy says new error responses should use this same shape with no wrapper object.
- Missing or bad token: status 401, body `{"status":"error","message":"missing authorization credentials"}`.
- Other errors: status 500, with the error message as the body.
- Comment not found or not owned (delete path): status 404 with an empty body. The notes don't say what edit returns in this case.

**Migrations:** The schema is `app/src/prisma/schema.prisma`. Migrations are in `app/src/prisma/migrations`, one timestamped folder each. There are four today. Apply them with `npx prisma migrate deploy`, using the `DATABASE_URL` environment variable. A demo policy says the `editedAt` migration must not change existing rows, and every new migration needs a one-line note on how to undo it.

**Tests:** Unit tests are Jest `*.test.ts` files under `app/src/tests/services` and `app/src/tests/utils`, run with `npx nx test api`. The database is mocked in `app/src/tests/prisma-mock.ts`, so they need no Postgres. End-to-end tests are in the separate `app/e2e` folder. A demo release checklist says to run the unit tests and `prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database before shipping.

entries.question: How long after a comment is created may its author edit it? After that window, what does the API do? Also: who may edit a comment, and does a comment deletion set deletedAt or remove the row?
entries.answer:
**Edit window:** Per the edit-window policy, an author may edit their comment for **15 minutes** after it was created. After that, **the API refuses the edit.** The notes don't give the status code or response body for that refusal.

**Who may edit:** The edit-window policy says a comment author may edit their own comment. The notes don't describe an edit endpoint's authorization check, so I can't confirm how it is enforced.

**Deletion:** The code records say deleting a comment **removes the row**. The Comment model has no `deletedAt` field, and deleteComment only looks up comments by id and author. The soft-delete policy, which would set `deletedAt` and keep the row, is labelled a demo policy and is not app behaviour.

Note that the edit-window and soft-delete sources are marked as demo policies, not actual app behaviour.
